# EAS Tools - Donations

## A small note on the topic of monetary donations:

First of all, thank you for even considering donating to support myself as a freelance developer for EAS Tools and related projects. I really appreciate it, and choosing to donate any amount is entirely your choice. I will never make this a paid tool (or any of my other projects), nor will I ever require payment for any features or services. However, if you wish to show your support and help cover the ongoing costs of hosting EAS Tools and the TTS service, my development efforts, or just want to say "thanks", any amount contribution would be greatly appreciated. You can find my current donation methods below:

### PayPal

You can donate via PayPal.me using the link below:

[Donate via PayPal.me](https://paypal.me/wagspuzzlespace)

### GitHub Sponsors

You can also support me on a recurring basis through GitHub Sponsors:

[Become a GitHub Sponsor](https://github.com/sponsors/wagwan-piffting-blud)

### Ko-fi

If you prefer to support me through Ko-fi, you can do so using the link below:

[Support me on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/wagspuzzlespace)

### Other Methods

If you prefer to use other methods or platforms to show your support not shown here, please feel free to reach out to me on GitHub, Discord, or through the contact form on [my personal website](https://wagspuzzle.space/contact), and we can discuss alternative ways for you to contribute. Again, thank you for your support, and I truly appreciate any contributions, whether monetary or simply sharing the tool with others who might find it useful!
